page_title: BOL 3-0 VEN | Bologna v Venezia 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Shots on target – 9:1.
85' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Joel Pohjanpalo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Antonio Raimondo (Venezia).
83' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) replaces Jens Odgaard.
83' Substitution. Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dan Ndoye walks off.
83' Looks like Michael Svoboda (Venezia) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
81' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
80' Emil Holm (Bologna) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
78' Bologna are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
75' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured John Yeboah leaves the pitch to be replaced by Domen Crnigoj (Venezia).
75' Substitution. Giorgio Altare (Venezia) has come on for Marin Sverko.
73' 63:37 – the latest ball possession ratio.
71' 3 - 0 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini puts the ball on a plate for Dan Ndoye (Bologna), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 3:0.
69' 2 - 0 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Filip Stankovic into the top left corner.
69' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
69' It’s a PENALTY to Bologna after the VAR review!
69' There's a break in play and referee Luca Massimi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bologna using VAR. This could be interesting!
68' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

67' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Filip Stankovic guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
66' Bologna keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
64' Here is a change. Santiago Castro is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
64' Substitution. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) on for Jesper Karlsson.
62' John Yeboah (Venezia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
60' John Yeboah (Venezia) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
58' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Filip Stankovic earns his money with a fine reflex save.

56' A sweet pass finds Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Filip Stankovic is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
53' Eusebio Di Francesco is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Alfred Duncan suffers an injury and John Yeboah (Venezia) comes on.
51' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
50' Lorenzo De Silvestri is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Emil Holm (Bologna).
48' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Eusebio Di Francesco probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia). He is replaced by Mikael Egill Ellertsson.
46' The whistle blows and Luca Massimi starts the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Juan Miranda (Bologna) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Juan Miranda (Bologna) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Filip Stankovic.
40' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
39' 5:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
36' Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul after Jens Odgaard (Bologna) hacks down one of his opponents.
34' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
33' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
32' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marin Sverko (Venezia) was quite harsh and Luca Massimi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

25' That's a well-taken pass by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
21' 1 - 0 Dan Ndoye (Bologna) slots home the penalty after firing the ball in the opposite direction to which the goalkeeper dives!
21' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
20' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul. A penalty is given to Bologna!
17' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the left post.
16' Bologna decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
15' The Bologna players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
12' The foul by Remo Freuler (Bologna) was seen by Luca Massimi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

10' Remo Freuler (Bologna) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
8' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
6' Bologna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
3' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Venezia will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Luca Massimi.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
